description: This is a C# test source file for the Orleans distributed grain directory system, specifically testing DhtGrainLocator functionalities including registration and unregistration of grains.

classes.name: DhtGrainLocatorTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of DhtGrainLocator, including grain unregistration and batch operation handling.

methods.name: SingleDeactivation
methods.description: Tests the unregistration of a single grain activation for each cause.

methods.name: MultipleDeactivations
methods.description: Tests batch unregistration of multiple grain activations with the same cause.

methods.name: MultipleMixedDeactivations
methods.description: Tests mixed batch unregistrations with different causes for multiple grain activations.

methods.name: GenerateActivationAddress
methods.description: Generates a new grain activation address for testing purposes.
